data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Memory.Ram.Short
data.value: Amount of RAM available to the emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Memory.Ram.Detailed
data.value: Selects the RAM expansion exposed by the emulation core. The machine must restart before the new amount is used.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Short
data.value: The system ROM is built into the emulation core.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Detailed
data.value: The emulation core provides the system ROM internally and does not expose a ROM file selector.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Resolution.Short
data.value: Internal resolution rendered by the emulation core.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Resolution.Detailed
data.value: Selects one of the internal resolutions exposed by the emulation core. This does not set the application window size.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Monitor.Short
data.value: Type of monitor emulated by the emulation core.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Monitor.Detailed
data.value: Selects a colour, green monochrome, or white monochrome Sega monitor.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Intensity.Short
data.value: Brightness of the emulated monitor.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Intensity.Detailed
data.value: Adjusts the monitor intensity from 5 to 15, as exposed by the emulation core.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Crop.Short
data.value: Removes the external screen border.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Video.Crop.Detailed
data.value: Asks the emulation core to crop the external border. GW GUI keeps the aspect ratio reported by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Audio.FloppySound.Short
data.value: Mechanical sound of the floppy drive.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Audio.FloppySound.Detailed
data.value: Enables or disables the floppy drive sound generated by the emulation core.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.General.Model.Short
data.value: Sega machine model being configured.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.General.Emulator.Short
data.value: Emulator selected for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.General.Emulator.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the emulator implementation used to run this machine configuration.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MasterSystem.Variant.Short
data.value: Master System hardware model.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MasterSystem.Variant.Detailed
data.value: Selects Master System I or Master System II hardware.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MasterSystem.ThreeDGlasses.Short
data.value: Master System 3-D Glasses.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MasterSystem.ThreeDGlasses.Detailed
data.value: Enables the 3-D Glasses interface and reserves the Sega Card slot.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.Model.Short
data.value: Mega Drive hardware model.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.Model.Detailed
data.value: Selects Mega Drive I or Mega Drive II hardware.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.Region.Short
data.value: Mega Drive region.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.Region.Detailed
data.value: Selects automatic, NTSC-U, NTSC-J, PAL or SECAM region behaviour.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.VideoStandard.Short
data.value: Mega Drive video standard.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.VideoStandard.Detailed
data.value: Selects automatic, 50 Hz or 60 Hz video timing.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Cpu.Model.Short
data.value: Processor emulated for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Cpu.Model.Detailed
data.value: Shows the processor model provided by the selected Sega machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Short
data.value: Original processor clock frequency.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Detailed
data.value: Shows the nominal clock frequency of the processor in the selected Sega machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Audio.Enabled.Short
data.value: Enable or disable emulated sound.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Audio.Enabled.Detailed
data.value: Controls whether GW GUI plays the audio samples generated by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Audio.Output.Short
data.value: Audio output used by GW GUI.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.Audio.Output.Detailed
data.value: Selects the Windows audio output used to play sound from this emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.General.Model.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the Sega model whose hardware configuration is being edited.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.MegaCd.Short
data.value: Mega-CD hardware model.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.MegaCd.Detailed
data.value: Selects Mega-CD I or Mega-CD II.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.MegaCd.Enabled.Short
data.value: Mega-CD

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.MegaCd.Enabled.Detailed
data.value: Enables Mega-CD. Its optical drive is added automatically.

data.name: Emulation.Sega.Help.MegaDrive.32X.Detailed
data.value: Enables 32X on the Mega Drive. It is disabled by default and 32X cartridges are available when it is enabled.
